values: Allied frigates have staged a successful attack against enemy shipping in Haeju harbour. Allied radar systems have detected enemy helicopters flying towards the allied task force. Scramble and defend our ships against the counter-attack.
Your prompt response and brilliant defensive action has enabled our ships to return home safely.  Congratulations on an outstanding performance.
Your successful defence of the task force has enabled the frigates to return home with minimal losses.
The loss of several frigates has been a major blow to our naval strength. Their senior commander has demanded an immediate enquiry into the effectiveness of the Apache crews.
